title: arnoglossum ovatum
intro: Arnoglossum ovatum, commonly known as Devil's Bells, is a flowering plant in the daisy family. It is used in herbal medicine to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Arnoglossum ovatum include wound healing, pain relief, and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified to include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
